title: An unqualified GN repeated until the GB status code
shapes: HKEP HKEPWALK 1000-SCAN: CALL 'CBLTDLI' USING WS-GN DB-PCB WS-IO-AREA, repeated by a recursive PERFORM while DB-STATUS = SPACES
asserts: HKEPWALK's 1000-SCAN CALL is one call_sites fact (CBLTDLI, resolves_to null) and one dli_calls fact: function GN (from WS-GN VALUE 'GN  '), pcb DB-PCB, io_area WS-IO-AREA, no ssas.

citations.quote: You would issue an unqualified GN call repeatedly until IMS returned a GB status code, indicating that it had reached the end of the database without being able to satisfy your call.

gaps.name: CBLTDLI
gaps.why: no member of the estate holds the program
